---
title: "UKHSA Data Analysis"
author: "Angela Duan"
---
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

In this section I load CSV data from the UKHSA data portal on the "Weekly positivity of people receiving a PCR test" for influenza.
```{r}
influenza <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download-influenza.csv")

gt(head(influenza))
```
Plotting the data
```{r}
ggplot(influenza, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "blue") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("Weekly Positivity") +
  ggtitle("Weekly Positivity of People Receiving a PCR Test for Influenza")
```
